variants.definition: Algorithm 1: Gprev=M=A=0 initially; difference=G-Gprev; A=beta_a*A+(1-beta_a)*difference; corrected=G+alpha*A; M=mu*M+corrected; O=NS(M,T); W=W-eta*(gamma*O+lambda*W); Gprev=G. gamma=0.2*sqrt(max(m,n)); nonmatrix AdamW fallback. Source momentum is unnormalized.
